LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_ModeRequestDesc: Drones fill this cell to its target. Stock above the target can supply other requests.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_ModeColonistRequest: Colonists haul items from the map or stockpiles until this cell reaches its target. Drones neither fill nor withdraw from this cell.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_ModeSupplyDesc: All stock is available as a drone source. Drones do not deposit loose items here.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_ModeGeneralDesc: Accepts items gathered by drones from player storage and supplies all stored stock to requests. Loose items and items reserved for colonist work are ignored.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_ModeExportDesc: Drones continuously move stock to allowed vanilla storage in the same network.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_ErrorRequestThing: Request-mode cells must lock a specific item.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_ErrorPinnedThing: Select an item before locking its type.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_ErrorCannotVirtuali: The selected item cannot be stored in a virtual logistics cell.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_ErrorNonemptyRebind: A nonempty cell cannot be rebound to another item. Empty it first.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_ErrorSelectCell: Select at least one storage cell.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_GizmoDesc: Configure the item, mode, and request target of each storage cell.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_HeaderSummary: Used {0}/{1} cells · Stock {2} · Request shortage {3} · In transit {4}
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_GridTitle: Storage cells · Drag to select, Ctrl to toggle, Shift for a range
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_Footer: Settings save immediately. Completed research expands existing boxes automatically.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_EditorInitial: Select cells, then configure their mode and item.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_AllowAutomaticClaim: Allow empty cells to claim items automatically
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_RequestBindingRequi: Request-mode cells must lock a specific item
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_SelectedAutomatic: No item locked; empty cells claim items as needed
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_EnableAutomaticClai: Clear item and enable automatic claiming
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_ResetDone: Selected empty cells are now general storage with automatic claiming enabled.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_ResetOccupied: All selected cells must have zero stock before they can be reset. Eject their stock first.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_NothingEjected: The selected cells have no stock to eject.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_HelpBinding: Automatic claiming only lets an empty cell accept any item on first deposit. It then stores that item only and releases it after both stock and inbound reservations reach zero. A locked item stays bound.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_HelpControls: Click to select; drag for a rectangle; Ctrl toggles cells; Shift selects a range. Conveyor input fills drone-request targets, colonist-request targets, matching stock, locked empty cells, then auto-claim cells; each stage follows cell ID order. Input and output ports work with every mode. Port placement alone determines direction.
LanguageData.Raven_DroneLogistics_TargetClamped: Target {0} exceeds this cell's range and was set to {1}.
